entries.76e10bcace9a9d21: This segment sells products and operates food and beverage businesses in Europe and the Americas. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating revenue from external customers was ¥42,133 million (up 7.9% year on year), and segment profit was ¥6,922 million (up 25.7%). The company explains that the number of stores fell year on year due to closures of unprofitable stores, while same-store sales grew, and cites that in Europe, profitability improved as unprofitable stores were closed under the structural reforms accompanying the previous year's business restructuring, and that in North America, expanded in-store inventory contributed to same-store sales growth, and closures of unprofitable stores in Canada also contributed to profit improvement. The segment has 558 employees (in addition, an annual average of 475 temporary employees).

The company defines its corporate philosophy as contributing to the realization of a "pleasant life and society" through products, services, stores and activities that consider the "desirable relationship among people, nature and things, and a spiritually rich human society," its first mission as "developing basic everyday product groups with sincere quality and from an ethical perspective, and providing products that improve society through their use at accessible prices," and its second mission as "stores having a role as community centers for each region, sharing issues and values with people in the region, working together on regional issues, and realizing a positive impact on the region." Product research and quality control are handled by the global sourcing companies in China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia and India.

Aimujisi (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED, PT. MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING INDONESIA, MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING (CAMBODIA) CO.,LTD. and MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED conduct research and quality control for MUJI products. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, there was no operating revenue from external customers; revenue consisted of intersegment internal operating revenue of ¥1,401 million. Segment profit was ¥73 million, and the segment had 107 employees. This segment supports the product-making side within the group and is not a segment that sells to outside consumers.
entries.9c4ff77f3a5e71f4: The group consists of the company and 28 subsidiaries, and its main business is the sale of its own brand products, "Mujirushi Ryohin" and "MUJI." It itself handles everything from product planning and development, product procurement and distribution processing to retail at directly managed stores, and also supplies products to business partners that operate stores exclusively selling "Mujirushi Ryohin" and "MUJI" (licensed stores). In other words, there are 2 sources of money: sales to consumers at its own directly managed stores and online store, and supply of products to business partners that operate licensed stores. In addition, it conducts food and beverage sales under the "Café&Meal MUJI" brand, operates campgrounds, sells housing, and sells products under the "IDÉE" brand. The reportable [[term:segment|segments]] are divided by region into 4 — the Japan Business, the East Asia Business, the Southeast Asia and Oceania Business, and the Europe and the Americas Business — plus the global sourcing business, which is not included in the reportable segments. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, there was no single external customer accounting for 10% or more of operating revenue.
entries.a5b7c05036263505: This segment sells products and operates food and beverage businesses in East Asia. MUJI (HONG KONG) CO.,LTD., MUJI (Shanghai) Commercial Co., Ltd. and Taiwan MUJI Co., Ltd. handle sales and food and beverage sales, and MUJI Korea Co.,Ltd. handles sales. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating revenue from external customers was ¥222,247 million (up 14.2% year on year), and segment profit was ¥42,794 million (up 20.4%), the second-largest scale after the domestic business. The company cites online sales growth in mainland China, driven by active promotional activities, with daily goods and food leading strong sales, and gross profit improvement from lower cost ratios and restrained price cuts as contributing factors. Taiwan and Hong Kong also posted higher revenue and profit, while Korea recorded higher revenue as same-store sales grew, but profit declined due to the impact of exchange rates. The segment has 6,594 employees (in addition, an annual average of 2,634 temporary employees), the largest of the reportable segments.
entries.b1e9688189c37ff6: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥784,629 million (up 18.6% from the previous fiscal year), and the company states that operating revenue and profits at each stage all reached record highs. The breakdown is net sales of goods and products of ¥779,864 million and operating income of ¥4,764 million. By product, household goods were ¥368,184 million (up 21.6% from the previous fiscal year), apparel and accessories were ¥285,294 million (up 14.7%), food was ¥104,655 million (up 21.6%), and other was ¥26,495 million (up 10.3%). Operating revenue to external customers by segment was ¥470,143 million for the Japan Business, ¥222,247 million for the East Asia Business, ¥50,105 million for the Southeast Asia and Oceania Business, and ¥42,133 million for the Europe and the Americas Business.
